verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring documents tracing, LLM call inspection, cost and token dashboards, and conversation replay on production traffic. Nothing in the evidence shows evaluators (scoring, LLM-as-judge, or quality metrics) running on live traffic or on offline datasets. Monitoring production AI spans and surfacing errors is an adjacent capability, not continuous evaluation, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets
